baseline.method: Independent original pyspeckit MPFIT on bound IRAM measurements

parameter_metric_definition: For each of four maps: max(abs(prediction-reference)/abs(reference)); positive nonzero bound reference values are required. Every map must pass.
observation_metric_definition: Maximum over nine pixels of sum(((T_model-T_observed)/noise)^2)/(501-4), noise=population std at radio velocities 20..28 km/s.
reference_kind: Standard-method result; no physical ground truth
tolerance_provenance: Frozen before extraction; original repeat identical, MPFIT stopping sensitivity max relative 1.3421499336145399e-5. Generic optimizer tolerance 2e-4.
